back.es: to throw, to toss; to put in, to add, to pour (salt, sugar, fuel); to kick out
back.example: Do you put sugar in your coffee? (literally: Do you add sugar to the coffee?)

note: On its own, "to pour" could mean servir or verter, so this card relies on the hint (salt, sugar, gas, not poner) to point to echar; the hint does that well enough and keeps it apart from the "to kick out" card.
